title: Pvt. Joe Lee Blakey Stationed At Howze
text:
Pvt. Joe Lee Blakey Stationed At Howze

Camp Howze is the army home of Pvt. Joe Lee Blakey, son of Mr. and Mrs. Tom Blakey of Savoy. Young Blakey, who was 20 years old July 28, was inducted Jan. 26 of this year at Camp Wolters and later was assigned to Camp Howze. He was a student at Savoy High School at the time of his induction.

His brother and sister, Robert and Mabelle Blakey, live at the family home in Savoy.
notes: Portrait photograph of Pvt. Joe Lee Blakey in uniform accompanies the article.
